comment.narrative: 1. The intervention supported Alay District in Osh Province in subitting a Good Practice Story to the Global Competition of the Green Destinations Platform . The intervention prepared the story ensured compliance with the 15 basic sustainability criteria and conducted required trainings in Alay. As a result Alay won a place among TOP 100 Good Practices of Green Destinations. This was promoted on regional and international levels to ensure dissemination of a good practice. 2. The intervention supported an educational workshop in Tashkent Dec 2022 to share project initiatives and results with counterparts from Uzbekistan. 3.The Intervention partnered with Samarkand Tourism Forum in Feb 2023 to disseminate best practices in sustainability integration. 3 panels were conducted on 1011 Feb 2023 in line with this partnership.

comment.narrative: The number of tourist arrivals in 2019 baseline year was around 8 000 000. This was a booming year for tourism. Due to COVID in 202021 and the political crisis of 2022 there are risks of not reaching the target of increase in arrivals. Nevertheless with the growing demand for sustainable offerings the uptake of sustainable tours is expected to increase. The baseline was therefore adjusted to 2020 numbers.
The target indicator will be adjusted in accordance with the pace of the tourism sector recovery. The number of arrivals UNWTO classification in 2021 was 3 563 524 and in 2020 2 244 900.

comment.narrative: Due to canellation of ITB initially planned in the proposal Greentour organized participation of the Kyrgyz tour operators in Travel Show Budapest 2022 on 36 Mar 2022.

On Mar 36 2022 4 tour operators supported by the intervention attended the International Travel Show Exhibition. The fair was selected due to cancellation of the initially proposed ITB Berlin. Tthrough EU Dels approval the intervention prepared and organized participation in the Budapest fair. 4 companies went but the presentations and promotional materials covered all 8 Travelife Partner companies certified by January 2022.2. In 2023 10 Travelife Partner firms attended ITB Berlin flights of 6 TOs were covered by the intervention. All 10 were supported with promotion on Travelife Awards ceremony at ITB business breakfast organized by GIZ Embassy and Greentor.
